highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.2 clears uniquely held Ganesh cache entries after failed flushes.

bullets.lead: Failed flushes no longer leave reusable uninitialized cache textures
bullets.detail: Drops uniquely held thread-safe-cache entries after unsuccessful GPU work so later draws cannot reuse those entries. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed.
